# Test-Privileged.ps1

Runs the Windows-targeted privileged acceptance suite separately from the fast suite. It requires a new, explicit `-EvidenceRoot` on a local fixed NTFS volume outside the repository, OneDrive, and Documents; it refuses an existing destination and checks existing ancestors for reparse points. The test root must be a separate local fixed NTFS directory outside the repository and synced user folders, have at least 40 GiB free, and contain no reparse ancestors. VHDX creation requires a caller-supplied GUID `-TestId`, a filename containing that GUID, and explicit `-ConfirmCreateVhdx`; the VHDX stays within the test-root volume. Before each storage mutation, the runner re-resolves the exact attached image and requires its unique disk-ID lookup to identify the same single file-backed disk; it excludes System/Boot and pagefile/crash-dump roles before disk changes and initialization, then verifies the unformatted partition and volume identity immediately before formatting. After any attempted VHDX creation it attempts to detach only that exact new path and verifies `Attached=false`; an unverifiable detach fails acceptance and is recorded. Failure evidence and the VHDX are retained. These static guards have not received physical Windows API verification and do not eliminate all OS-level TOCTOU; do not run until the physical audit says `PASS`.
